name: Muscat International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways: 08R/26L 4,080 m x 45 m and 08L/26R 4,000 m x 60 m

hours.v: aerodrome administration, fuelling and handling 24 hours

ppr.v: non-scheduled and private flights need prior permission (PPR) 72 hours ahead
ppr.quote: Non-scheduled and private flights PPR 72 hrs.

noise.v: landing on runway 08L between 20:00 and 06:00 local (16:00-02:00 UTC), reverse thrust may not exceed idle unless needed for safety
noise.quote: arrivals on RWY 08L between 1600 and 0200 UTC may not exceed idle reverse thrust.

notes: Read Oman eAIP AD 2 OOMS (HTML) in the AIRAC AIP AMDT 02/25 edition (published 17 Apr 2025, effective 15 May 2025). A newer edition exists (AIRAC AIP AMDT 02/26, published 30 Apr 2026, https://aim.caa.gov.om/eAIP_Oman/final/2026-06-11/html/cover-en-GB.html) but its AD 2 OOMS page could not be opened (permission not answered); re-check before publishing. All AD 2.3 services are H24; no curfew stated. Stands are allocated by the airport company (OAMC). No instrument training flights 0300-0900 UTC for CAT A and B. Hangar space unavailable. Oman is UTC+4 with no daylight saving. IATA code not printed (MCT appears only as a navaid identifier).
